show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Kyle Samani and Tushar Jain - Multicoin Capital (Manager Meetings, EP.20)
thesis: This episode argues that Helium represents a significant business model innovation comparable to established platforms like Airbnb or Uber, and highlights its practical utility by noting that major corporations like Nestle are already using the Helium network to track vending machine inventory.

claims.claim: Helium is a business model innovation similar to Airbnb or Uber.
claims.quote: Helium is a business model innovation. It's not a technology innovation, really. It's a business model innovation in the same way that Airbnb or Uber are business model innovations.

claims.claim: Helium network is being used by Nestle to track vending machine inventory.
claims.quote: And now there are a number of high-prof customers that use a Helium network, such as Nestle is using the network in order to track vending machine inventory.
